title: LoL 7 a 0 — Player Database
description: Schema for public/players.json. Provides autocomplete and inline validation in VS Code.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference (VS Code autocomplete helper — ignored at runtime).

name.description: Pack name shown in the editor and lobby.

players.description: Array of player cards. Each card represents one player in one career year.

Role.description: One of the five LoL roles.

Mastery.description: Champion mastery: 1 = low familiarity, 5 = signature champion.

Trait.description: One of the 15 player traits from the catalogue.

championId.description: Champion identifier — lowercase, hyphens for spaces (e.g. 'kog-maw').

top.description: Strength in the top lane role. Set to 0 if this player does not play top.

jungle.description: Strength in the jungle role. Set to 0 if this player does not jungle.

mid.description: Strength in the mid lane role. Set to 0 if this player does not play mid.

adc.description: Strength in the ADC role. Set to 0 if this player does not play ADC.

support.description: Strength in the support role. Set to 0 if this player does not play support.

personId.description: Person-level ID for roster uniqueness (no duplicate person per team). Lowercase, no spaces.

displayName.description: Name shown in the UI, e.g. 'Faker 2016'.

year.description: Optional card year. Range: 2011–2035. Cards without a year show no year.

roles.description: Roles this player can fill. At least 1, at most 5.

primaryRole.description: The role the draft engine uses when slotting this player. Must be one of the values in 'roles'.

roleStrength.description: Strength per role (0–100). All five keys required; unplayed roles carry 0.

traits.description: Special player traits, max 4. Use [] for no trait. See DATA-DICTIONARY.md for the full catalogue.

championPool.description: Champions this player knows. Minimum 8 required for fearless Bo5 draft.
